dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: I find the tỷ lệ tội phạm in Saigon much lower than in Moscow. Do you cảm thấy an toàn living here?

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: That's right, the tỷ lệ tội phạm here is quite low compared to many other big cities. I cảm thấy an toàn when đi bộ at night, unlike in America.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: Hmph, but you can't deny that snatching issues still exist. Last week I almost had my phone snatched while đi bộ near my home.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I'm sorry about that. Perhaps... I should accompany you more often to ensure safety? I know some an toàn shortcuts.

dialogue.speaker: Mira
dialogue.text: You nghĩ I need a protector? I've sống in Moscow! But... perhaps going together would be more interesting.

dialogue.speaker: Michael
dialogue.text: I don't nghĩ you need protection, but I want to spend more time with you. Where do you think the tỷ lệ tội phạm is scarier - Saigon or Moscow? TITLE_CARD: Dangerous Streets or Date Excuse?
